description: This file defines the LengthClass controller for the OpenCart admin module related to localisation. It handles listing, adding, editing, and saving length class entries used for measurements within the localization settings of OpenCart.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Controller class managing CRUD operations and display for length measurement units in localisation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that displays the list of length classes with sorting and pagination options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list all length classes, mainly calling getList and outputting it.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of length classes, sorted and paginated.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a length class.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to add or update a length class.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected length classes, including permission check and JSON response.
